caption: The video captures a snow-dusted small-town street at night, its storefronts outlined in warm string lights, including a brick florist building on the right. A red SUV sits parked at the curb on the right. A dark car rests on the left, both unmoving throughout. From the far-left background, a vehicle's headlights brighten as it draws nearer down the road, resolving into a white SUV that grows larger. The SUV advances along the left side of the street, headlights flaring toward the camera, then sweeps across the foreground from left to right with motion blur. Its taillights slip past the right edge, leaving the lit street alone for the final frames.
relations: The far-left headlight source advances toward the camera, its apparent size growing along the left curb.
The approaching SUV sweeps across the foreground left-to-right, blurring motion under the warm string lights.
The red SUV and dark car stay parked and stationary as the moving vehicle passes between them.
After the SUV exits right, its taillights leave the lit snowy street alone in the final frames.
